sentences.text:
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.IR.) lodged on 16.6.2022 against a single named accused Kavita, who is the informant's daughter-in-law, alleging that she and the informant's daughter Pooja, aged about 17 years, had gone somewhere at 7.6.2022 and they did not come back.
4.

In the statement of the informant's daughter recorded under section 161, CrPC she stated that she is aged 18 years; She had gone with her Bhabhi to Chhatarpur; at Chhatarpur the named accused Kavita married one Ram Prasad and five days thereafter the victim/informant's daughter married the applicant and that she is living with the applicant as his wife.

Before the Magistrate also the Suresh Ahirwar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109358432/

5. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the accused on bail.
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
6. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
7. Let the applicant Suresh Ahirwar S/o late Deen Dayal be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime No. 159 of 2022, under sections 376 IPC and section , Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 , P.S. Sirsiya, District Shrawasti, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
8.
